audit_status.source_base: Greek 1 Thessalonians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for holiness, sexual ethics without body-hatred, sibling love, quiet work, resurrection comfort, Lord's arrival.

verses.restored: Finally then, siblings, we ask and appeal to you in Lord Jesus, that just as you received from us how it is necessary for you to walk and please the Divine, just as indeed you are walking, that you abound still more.

familiar.text: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.

verses.restored: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

familiar.text: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.

verses.restored: For this is the will of the Divine, your sanctification: that you abstain from sexual immorality/misuse,

familiar.text: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

verses.restored: that each of you know how to possess one's own vessel/body in holiness and honor,

familiar.text: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;

verses.restored: not in passion of desire like the nations who do not know the Divine,

familiar.text: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:

verses.restored: that no one transgress and exploit one's sibling in the matter, because the Lord is avenger concerning all these things, just as also we told you before and solemnly testified.

familiar.text: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.

verses.restored: For the Divine did not call us into uncleanness, but in holiness.

familiar.text: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.

verses.restored: Therefore the one rejecting this does not reject a human but the Divine, the One giving his holy Spirit into you.

familiar.text: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.

verses.restored: Now concerning sibling-love, you have no need for me to write to you, for you yourselves are taught by the Divine to love one another.

familiar.text: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.

verses.restored: For indeed you are doing this toward all the siblings in all Macedonia. But we appeal to you, siblings, to abound still more,

familiar.text: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;

verses.restored: and to aspire to be quiet, and to attend to your own things, and to work with your hands, just as we instructed you,

familiar.text: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;

verses.restored: so that you may walk honorably toward those outside and have need of no one.

familiar.text: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.

verses.restored: But we do not want you to be unaware, siblings, concerning those who sleep, so that you may not grieve as also the rest who have no hope.

familiar.text: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.

verses.restored: For if we trust that Jesus died and rose, so also through Jesus the Divine will bring with him those who slept.

familiar.text: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

verses.restored: For this we say to you by word of the Lord, that we the living, those remaining until the presence/arrival of the Lord, will certainly not precede those who slept.

familiar.text: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.

verses.restored: Because the Lord himself, with command, with voice of archangel and trumpet of Divine, will descend from heaven, and the dead in Messiah will rise first.

familiar.text: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:

verses.restored: Then we the living, those remaining, will be caught up together with them in clouds into meeting of the Lord in air; and so we will always be with the Lord.

familiar.text: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

verses.restored: Therefore comfort/encourage one another with these words.

familiar.text: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.

translation_notes: Sexual ethics are framed as holiness, honor, and non-exploitation, not body-hatred.
Sleep is used as death imagery; the point is hope and mutual comfort, not speculative timeline control.
Parousia is presence/arrival to preserve royal-visit sense.
